_doc: Fields (all optional; unset falls back to `default`, then to playwright.config.ts):
- maxDiffPixelRatio  0..1  ratio of differing pixels to total. Prefer this over maxDiffPixels — it scales with viewport.
- maxDiffPixels      int   absolute cap on differing pixels. Use for tiny element screenshots where a ratio rounds to 0.
- threshold          0..1  per-pixel YIQ color-distance tolerance before a pixel is counted as 'different'.
Playwright default is 0.2. Raise to 0.25–0.35 for font-hinting / anti-aliasing noise.
This is the knob for 'ignore minor AA'. Do NOT bump maxDiffPixelRatio to hide AA noise.
Lookup order for a screenshot named `foo-bar-mobile.png` in `tests/visual/foo.spec.ts`:
Screenshot names support the same `*` glob as picomatch (e.g. `mobile-fab-*.png`).

default._why: Skeleton shimmer + status-badge tone swatches sit on tinted surfaces where AA on rounded corners fluctuates 1–2 subpixels across Playwright patch versions.
Element screenshots are ~44×44 → ratio rounds to 0. Absolute pixel cap catches real changes (icon size, padding drift) while ignoring AA on the FAB's white plus icon and NavLink icon strokes.

mobile-bottom-nav-*.png._why: Full-width nav bar — 5 icons × subpixel AA on active-tab stroke weight.

default._why: Full-viewport iPad snapshots — sidebar row hover, table zebra, and chart axis labels all AA-render subpixel jitter across Playwright patch versions. Tighter budgets go on per-surface overrides below.

tablet-erp-dashboard-*.png._why: Dashboard KPI cards + charts — the largest AA surface area in the ERP.

tablet-erp-ledger-*.png._why: Ledger is mostly typography on flat surfaces — keep the budget tight so a real column-alignment regression can't hide.

ledger-booking-picker-*.png._why: Combobox chevron + border stroke are the only signal — keep threshold tight.

ledger-whatsapp-button-*.png._why: Green WhatsApp glyph on white — AA around the phone earpiece curve is the dominant noise source.
